subject: LuminaHealth — Post-demo: data handling confirmation & next steps
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@luminahealth.com>, Lucas Reid <lucas@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-09T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: LuminaHealth — post-demo: data handling confirmation & next steps

Hi Elena / Lucas — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

1) Ask you confirmed: you need a guarantee that any customer content sent to Redwood's hosted API will not be used to train or fine-tune Redwood models or third-party models.
2) Residency: production workloads must remain in us-west with audit logs kept in-region.
3) Logging & retention: you requested minimal request logging, redaction of PII in traces, and a 90-day max retention window for token-level logs.

Next steps (what we'll deliver):
- I will send a written confirmation that Redwood will not use LuminaHealth data for model improvements (no-training/no-fine-tuning) and outline what we log by default vs what can be disabled.
- Marissa will follow up with suggested SOW language and a draft mutual action plan (MAP) to capture residency and retention SLAs.
- Aditya can provide a short technical note on PII sanitization options (edge redaction vs. in-flight).

Attachments: I'll attach a short Data Handling Summary and a draft MAP for your review.

If that aligns, we'll prepare a one-page addendum you can attach to the contract.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Eng, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0184
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Morales <elena@luminahealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lucas Reid <lucas@luminahealth.com>
Date: 2028-05-09T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: LuminaHealth — post-demo: data handling confirmation & next steps

Thanks Hannah — that matches our notes. A couple of clarifying items before you draft the formal language: 

- By 'not used to train', can you explicitly commit that neither Redwood nor its partners will use LuminaHealth customer content (including snippets in support transcripts, clinician notes, or anonymized datasets we send) to improve any model weights or downstream model-hosting datasets? We need that in writing for our security/compliance review.
- For logs: we need the ability to turn off request-body retention entirely in the hosted plan (we may still send metadata). Is that configurable per-account?
- Residency: confirm logs and any backups are kept in us-west and will not be replicated to other regions.

Also, we'll require evidence for SOC 2 controls around log access for the last 30 days — typically a CSV listing access events is sufficient. Can you provide a template or sample report?

If you can include explicit language on the no-training commitment, per-account toggle to disable request-body retention, and an approach for log access evidence, we can move quickly.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Privacy & Compliance, LuminaHealth
elena@luminahealth.com | (617) 555-0212

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@luminahealth.com>, Lucas Reid <lucas@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-10T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: LuminaHealth — post-demo: data handling confirmation & next steps

Elena — thanks for the concrete list, that helps. High-level responses below and I've attached a short 'Data Handling Summary' that we maintain for initial diligence.

- No-training commitment: Redwood will provide an addendum that states we will not use LuminaHealth customer content for model training or to improve any Redwood-managed models or third-party models unless LuminaHealth provides an explicit, documented opt-in. This covers all content types you called out (support transcripts, clinician notes, anonymized datasets).

- Request-body retention toggle: Yes — for hosted accounts we offer a per-account setting to disable request-body persistence. When disabled, request bodies are not written to persistent logging storage; ephemeral metadata and metrics for billing/usage remain. We'll include the exact field names and API flags in the tech note.

- Residency: we will ensure primary logging and backups are maintained in us-west region for your account. Cross-region replication is disabled by default for accounts with a residency constraint; we'll include the tenancy config in the MAP.

- Evidence for SOC 2 controls: we can produce an access event report (CSV) for the last 30 days that includes actor, timestamp, resource, and action. We will provide a sample CSV and a redaction-safe example.

Attached: redwood_data_handling_summary.pdf (summary of logs, retention options, redact/scrubbing patterns), lumina_mutual_action_plan.xlsx (draft MAP with residency and retention rows).

Next step: Marissa — could you capture the SLA language and produce a one-page addendum draft? Aditya — can you send the API flag names + PII redaction options in a short note by EOD?

Thanks — Hannah

---
Attachments:
- redwood_data_handling_summary.pdf (type: application/pdf)
- lumina_mutual_action_plan.xlsx (type: application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Date: 2028-05-10T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: LuminaHealth — post-demo: data handling confirmation & next steps

Elena — looping in draft language below that we can include in an addendum / MAP. Happy to iterate.

Draft addendum excerpt (proposed):
• Non-training clause: "Redwood Inference shall not use, process, or incorporate Customer Content for the purpose of training, improving, or re‑training any machine learning models or datasets, whether proprietary or third‑party, without Customer's prior written consent."
• Log retention: "Token-level request logs and request bodies will be retained for a maximum of ninety (90) days unless Customer elects to enable the 'no-persistence' flag, in which case request bodies will not be persisted."
• Residency: "Primary data storage and backups for Customer's account shall be provisioned and maintained in the us-west region. Cross-region replication will remain disabled unless otherwise agreed in writing."

If that aligns, I'll convert to official language and produce a one-page addendum for signature.

Marissa Cole
Lead Contracts Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

1) Can you add a sentence that Redwood will provide an access-log CSV extract on request covering the prior 30 days, within 3 business days of request?
2) We'll want a DocuSign-ready addendum so legal can sign quickly.

Assuming those are included, we're good to proceed — please send the addendum and the DocuSign link.
